en: A doctor who looks after your teeth.
ex: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
我明天跟牙醫有約。

en: A part of a large organization such as a school or company; or a part of a government; or a section of a store.
ex: She works in the sales department of a large company.
她在一家大公司的業務部門工作。

en: To need someone or something for support; or to be affected or decided by something else.
ex: Our trip depends on the weather tomorrow.
我們的旅行要看明天的天氣。

en: The distance from the top to the bottom of something; or the quality of being deep.
ex: The depth of the swimming pool is two meters.
這座游泳池的深度是兩公尺。

en: To say or write what someone or something is like.
ex: Can you describe the man you saw?
你能描述一下你看到的那個男人嗎？

en: A statement that says what someone or something is like; or a kind or type of something.
ex: The police asked for a description of the thief.
警方要求描述那名小偷的特徵。

en: A large, dry area of land with little rain and few plants; or to leave someone or something without help.
ex: Camels can travel for days across the desert.
駱駝能穿越沙漠走上好幾天。

en: To plan how something will look or work; or a drawing or plan; or the way something is made.
ex: She designs clothes for a famous fashion company.
她為一家著名的時裝公司設計服裝。

en: A small fact or piece of information about something; or the small features of something.
ex: Please tell me all the details of your plan.
請告訴我你計畫的所有細節。

en: To grow or change slowly into something bigger or better; or to make a film using chemicals.
ex: The company developed a new type of phone.
公司開發了一款新型手機。

en: A conversation between two or more people, especially in a book, play or film.
ex: We practiced the dialogue in pairs in class.
我們在課堂上兩人一組練習對話。

en: A very hard, clear stone that is worth a lot of money; or a shape with four equal sides, like a rotated square.
ex: He gave her a ring with a small diamond.
他送給她一枚鑲著小鑽石的戒指。

en: The way in which two things are not the same; or the amount by which they are not the same.
ex: There is a big difference between the two cities.
這兩座城市有很大的差異。

en: A problem or situation that is hard to deal with; or the quality of being hard to do or understand.
ex: She had difficulty finding a job after graduation.
她畢業後很難找到工作。

en: Going straight without turning or stopping; or honest; or to manage or control something; or to show the way.
ex: There is a direct bus from the airport to the city.
有直達公車從機場到市區。

en: The way that something is moving or facing; or the way in which something is developing; or instructions for doing something.
ex: They walked in the direction of the railway station.
他們朝火車站的方向走去。

en: To have a different opinion from someone; or to be different from something.
ex: I disagree with you about the new school rules.
我不同意你對新校規的看法。

en: To stop being visible or to go away so that you cannot be found; or to stop existing.
ex: The cat disappeared behind the garden wall.
貓消失在花園牆後面。

en: To talk about something with someone in order to decide something or share ideas.
ex: We discussed our plans for the summer holiday.
我們討論了暑假的計畫。

en: A conversation about something, especially to decide what to do; or a long talk on a subject.
ex: The class had a long discussion about environmental problems.
全班就環境問題進行了長時間的討論。

en: An illness of the body or mind, especially one caused by infection.
ex: Doctors are working to find a cure for the disease.
醫生們正努力尋找治療這種疾病的方法。

en: To put something in a place where people can see it; or an act of showing something; or the screen of a device.
ex: The shop displayed new clothes in the window.
商店在櫥窗裡展示新衣服。

en: The amount of space between two places or things; or a far-off place.
ex: The school is a short distance from my home.
學校離我家不遠。

en: Far away in space or time; or not friendly or close.
ex: We heard the distant sound of thunder.
我們聽到遠處的雷聲。

en: To separate something into parts; or to share something among people; or to do division in math.
ex: The teacher divided the class into four groups.
老師把班上分成四組。

en: The act of dividing something into parts; or the math operation of dividing; or one of the parts of a large organization.
ex: She works in the marketing division of the company.
她在公司的行銷部工作。

en: Relating to the home or family; or inside one's own country; or (of animals) kept as pets.
ex: Dogs and cats are common domestic animals.
狗和貓是常見的家畜。

en: A small round mark; or a full stop in writing; or to put small marks on something.
ex: There was a small red dot on the map.
地圖上有一個小紅點。

en: To copy information from the internet to your computer; or a file that is copied this way.
ex: I downloaded the app to my phone.
我把這個應用程式下載到手機裡。

en: On or to a lower floor of a building; or the lower floor of a building.
ex: Please come downstairs; dinner is ready.
請下樓來，晚餐好了。

en: A large imaginary animal in stories, with wings, claws and breath of fire; also a symbol in Chinese culture.
ex: In the story, a brave knight killed the dragon.
在故事裡，一位勇敢的騎士殺死了那條龍。

en: A play for the theater, television or radio; or the art of writing and acting plays; or an exciting situation.
ex: She is studying drama at university.
她在大學學戲劇。

en: A part of a desk or cupboard that you pull out to keep things in.
ex: She put the keys in the top drawer of the desk.
她把鑰匙放在書桌最上面的抽屜裡。

en: A picture made with a pen or pencil; or the activity of making pictures like this.
ex: The child made a drawing of his family.
那個孩子畫了一幅他家人的圖畫。

en: A medicine; or an illegal substance people take for pleasure; or to give someone a drug.
ex: Doctors prescribed a new drug to treat the illness.
醫生開了一種新藥來治療這種疾病。

en: A machine for drying clothes or hair.
ex: She put the wet clothes in the dryer.
她把濕衣服放進乾衣機。

en: Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time; or needing to be paid; or because of something.
ex: The homework is due on Friday.
功課星期五要交。

en: Not interesting or exciting; or not sharp; or not bright or clear; or to make something less strong.
ex: The speech was so dull that many people fell asleep.
那場演講太無聊，很多人都睡著了。

en: Something that you must do because it is your job or the right thing; or a tax on imported goods.
ex: It is every citizen's duty to obey the law.
遵守法律是每位公民的責任。

en: A large bird with a hooked beak and strong claws that hunts small animals; also a symbol of some countries.
ex: An eagle flew high above the mountains.
一隻老鷹在群山上空高高飛翔。
